text:
Alex Chen: heads-up — i'll be swapping primary to maria in ~10m due to timezone. primary->secondary handoff below, gaps noted. :wave:
Oncall Bot: paging history: 1903451000 - SLOW_TOKENIZE errors spiking on prod-inference-1 (severity: P2)
Alex Chen: quick summary: we still have an open incident (SLOW_TOKENIZE) causing intermittent latency spikes for short prompts; traffic routing is falling back to smaller model variants which is increasing token churn. customers affected: product-search and chat-api.
Maria Gomez: acknowledged. i can take primary in ~6m. what are the immediate runbook links?
Alex Chen: runbook links: https://go.redwood/runbooks/latency-spikes , https://go.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback , fallback playbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/model-routing-fallback
Alex Chen: immediate checklist (short):
- confirm primary/secondary swap on call rota: update sheet (https://go.redwood/oncall/rotation)
- confirm access to prod project for new primary (IAM: redwood-prod-admin)
- run quick KV cache health: `curl -s https://obs.redwood.internal/cache/health | jq .`
- if prefix cache miss rate > 20% -> trigger manual prefix warm: `python infra/tools/warm_prefix.py --prefixes "common:user:/*"`
- if tail latency > 500ms for p95 -> scale inference pool `kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=6 -n redwood-serving`
Maria Gomez: i've got prod access and rotated creds. i'll update rota after swap. will run cache health check now. :thumbsup:
Jamal Singh: heads-up — i lost SSH to worker-23 from my laptop during the last spike, might be related to node oom. check node metrics: `kubectl top node worker-23` and `kubectl describe pod inference-23-abcde`
Maria Gomez: cache health: `{"prefix_miss_pct": 18, "kv_latency_ms": 12}` — miss pct below threshold. node metrics look ok for now.
Priya Patel: quick mitigations if we see repeat spikes:
1) toggle routing policy to favor low-latency slices (short-term): `POST /v1/routing/policy -d '{"policy":"latency-first","weight":0.8}'` (requires ops token)
2) enable request-level batching limiter to reduce burst: update config `batcher.max_batch_wait_ms = 15`
3) rollback last model variant canary (if quality not needed): `deploy-bot rollback inference-model:2026-03-12-canary`
Alex Chen: thanks priya. Maria — when you take primary, please run these in order: 1) confirm rota, 2) sanity runbooks links, 3) re-run `kubectl scale` only if p95 latency still > 500ms. avoid rolling restarts unless we have clear node-level OOMs.
Maria Gomez: i'm primary now. updated rotation sheet and pinned runbooks to the channel. also added a short note in the incident ticket: https://go.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-091
Oncall Bot: reminder scheduled: handoff-checklist in 30m for new primary
Jamal Singh: i opened a short-term ticket to investigate worker-oom correlation with KV cache eviction pattern — ticket RED-OPS-612. i'll take postmortem if needed.
Maria Gomez: quick ops commands i ran:
```
kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=6 -n redwood-serving
curl -s https://obs.redwood.internal/cache/metrics | jq '.prefix_evictions | .[]'
deploy-bot status inference-model:2026-03-12-canary
```
Maria Gomez: after scaling, p95 dropped from 720ms -> 320ms for chat-api. will monitor for next 20m. :white_check_mark:
Priya Patel: if it regressses, run this fallback (manual routing to stable):
```
# route all chat-api to stable-small for 10m
POST /v1/routing/override -d '{"service":"chat-api","variant":"stable-small","duration":"10m"}'
```
Alex Chen: closing notes for handoff:
- primary: Maria Gomez (confirmed)
- secondary: Jamal Singh (on-call if Maria needs escalation)
- coverage gap: no infra engineer in APAC overnight (no immediate fix, listed in rota).
- critical runbooks pinned: latency-spikes, kv-cache-fallback, model-routing-fallback
- escalation path: Pager -> Slack #eng-oncall -> Call SRE Lead (Priya) if >30m unresolved or customer SLA breach
Maria Gomez: will update thread with final status after 20m monitoring window. thanks all. :pray:
Deploy Bot: rollback suggestion triggered for inference-model:2026-03-12-canary (action required by primary)
Maria Gomez: noted. i will not rollback yet — watching telemetry for another 10m then decide.
Jamal Singh: tagging ops logs i'll need for postmortem: https://storage.redwood.internal/logs/2026-03-12/spike-1903451000.tar.gz
Maria Gomez: final update — 45m after handoff: latency stabilized, no further paging. leaving primary for next 4h, setting reminder to hand back at 1903470000. :tada:
